```{r}
# ==========================================
# Method 1: Linear logistic regression + Wald inference (REAL DATA)
# Outcome: adult obesity (Wave IV, BMI>=30)
# Exposure: adolescent MVPA composite (Wave I)
# Covariates (per essay): sex, age, race/ethnicity, income, parental education, baseline BMI
# Note: public-use files do NOT contain weights/PSU/strata -> unweighted associational analysis
# ==========================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Use the shared, essay-aligned data pipeline
source("shared_setup.R")
dat <- make_analysis_dataset("wave1.csv", "wave4.csv")

cat("Method 1 analytic N =", nrow(dat), "\n")
cat("Obesity prevalence =", round(mean(dat$obese), 4), "\n")
summary(dat$mvpa)

# ---- Fit linear logistic regression (Wald inference) ----
fit1 <- glm(
  obese ~ mvpa +
    female +
    age_w1 +
    race_eth +
    income_w1 +
    parent_educ_w1 +
    bmi_w1,
  data = dat,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)

# ---- TRUE Wald inference (model-based SE + normal approx) ----
b  <- coef(fit1)
se <- sqrt(diag(vcov(fit1)))
z  <- qnorm(0.975)

ci_low  <- b - z * se
ci_high <- b + z * se

zstat <- b / se
pval  <- 2 * pnorm(abs(zstat), lower.tail = FALSE)

tab_wald <- data.frame(
  term = names(b),
  estimate_logodds = b,
  se = se,
  ci_low_logodds = ci_low,
  ci_high_logodds = ci_high,
  p_value = pval,
  OR = exp(b),
  OR_low = exp(ci_low),
  OR_high = exp(ci_high),
  row.names = NULL
) %>%
  mutate(
    term = dplyr::recode(
      term,
      `(Intercept)` = "Intercept",
      mvpa = "MVPA (per 1 bout/week)",
      female = "Female (1 vs 0)",
      age_w1 = "Age at Wave I (years)",
      income_w1 = "Household income (Wave I)",
      parent_educ_w1 = "Parental education (Wave I)",
      bmi_w1 = "Baseline BMI (Wave I self-report)"
    ),
    # Make race/ethnicity terms readable
    term = ifelse(grepl("^race_eth", term),
                  gsub("^race_eth", "Race/ethnicity: ", term),
                  term)
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4)))

print(tab_wald)

# Save results for your paper pipeline
saveRDS(list(model = fit1, table = tab_wald), "method1_glm_wald_results.rds")

# ---- Optional Figure: predicted obesity probability vs MVPA (male vs female) ----
mvpa_seq <- seq(min(dat$mvpa), max(dat$mvpa), length.out = 200)

# pick a reference race/eth that exists
ref_race <- levels(dat$race_eth)[which(levels(dat$race_eth) %in% unique(na.omit(dat$race_eth)))[1]]

base_vals <- dat %>%
  summarise(
    age_w1 = mean(age_w1, na.rm = TRUE),
    income_w1 = mean(income_w1, na.rm = TRUE),
    parent_educ_w1 = mean(parent_educ_w1, na.rm = TRUE),
    bmi_w1 = mean(bmi_w1, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

grid <- expand.grid(
  mvpa = mvpa_seq,
  female = c(0, 1)
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    age_w1 = base_vals$age_w1,
    income_w1 = base_vals$income_w1,
    parent_educ_w1 = base_vals$parent_educ_w1,
    bmi_w1 = base_vals$bmi_w1,
    race_eth = factor(ref_race, levels = levels(dat$race_eth)),
    sex_label = ifelse(female == 1, "Female", "Male")
  )

# do predict AFTER all columns exist
grid$pred <- predict(fit1, newdata = grid, type = "response")

p_m1 <- ggplot(grid, aes(x = mvpa, y = pred, linetype = sex_label)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    x = "Weekly MVPA bouts (midpoint composite)",
    y = "Predicted probability of adult obesity",
    title = "Method 1: Linear logistic regression predictions by sex",
    linetype = "Sex"
  )

ggsave("fig_method1_glm_predictions.png", p_m1, width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 300)
p_m1


```


```{r}
dat_cat <- dat %>%
mutate(
mvpa_cat = cut(
mvpa,
breaks = c(-Inf, 0, 4, 9, Inf),
labels = c("0", "1--4", "5--9", ">=10"),
right = TRUE
)
) %>%
group_by(mvpa_cat) %>%
summarise(
prev_obese = mean(obese),
n = n(),
.groups = "drop"
)

p2 <- ggplot(dat_cat, aes(x = mvpa_cat, y = prev_obese)) +
geom_col() +
labs(
x = "Adolescent MVPA category (bouts/week)",
y = "Adult obesity prevalence (Wave IV)",
title = "Adult obesity prevalence by adolescent MVPA"
)

ggsave("fig2_obesity_by_mvpa_category.png", p2, width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 300)
p2
```
